title: Tripterygium wilfordii Hook.f induced kidney injury through mediating inflammation via PI3K-Akt/HIF-1/TNF signaling pathway: A study of network toxicology and molecular docking.
authors: Yang, Shuo; Wang, Mengmeng; Li, Zhongming; Luan, Xiangjia; Yu, Yanan; Jiang, Junjie; Li, Yuanyuan; Xie, Yanming; Wang, Lianxin
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络毒理学和分子对接研究雷公藤致肾损伤的炎症机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: We intend to explore potential mechanisms of Tripterygium wilfordii Hook.f (TwHF) induced kidney injury (KI) using the methods of network toxicology and molecular docking. We determined TwHF potential compounds with its targets and KI targets, obtained the TwHF induced KI targets after intersecting targets of TwHF and KI. Then we conducted protein-protein interaction (PPI) network, gene expression analysis, gene ontology (GO) function and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analysis to explore the mechanism of TwHF-induced KI. Finally we conducted molecular docking to verify the core toxic compounds and the targets. We obtained 12 TwHF toxic compounds and 62 TwHF-induced KI targets. PPI network, gene expression analysis and GO function enrichment analysis unveiled the key biological process and suggested the mechanism of TwHF-induced KI might be associated with inflammation, immune response, hypoxia as well as oxidative stress. KEGG pathway enrichment analysis indicated PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, HIF-1 signaling pathway and TNF signaling pathway were key signaling pathways of TwHF induced KI. Molecular docking showed that the binding energy of core targets and toxic compounds was all less than -6.5 kcal/mol that verified the screening ability of network pharmacology and provided evidence for modifying TwHF toxic compounds structure. Through the study, we unveiled the mechanism of TwHF induce KI that TwHF might activate PI3K-Akt signaling pathway as well as TNF signaling pathway to progress renal inflammation, mediate hypoxia via HIF-1 signaling pathway to accelerate inflammatory processes, and also provided a theoretical basis for modifying TwHF toxic compounds structure as well as supported the follow-up research.
abstract_zh: 我们旨在利用网络毒理学和分子对接的方法，探索雷公藤（Tripterygium wilfordii Hook.f, TwHF）诱导肾损伤（kidney injury, KI）的潜在机制。我们确定了TwHF的潜在化合物及其靶点，以及KI靶点，通过交集TwHF和KI靶点获得TwHF诱导KI的靶点。随后，我们进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络、基因表达分析、基因本体（gene ontology, GO）功能及京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes, KEGG）通路富集分析，以探索TwHF诱导KI的机制。最后，我们进行了分子对接以验证核心毒性化合物与靶点。我们获得了12种TwHF毒性化合物和62个TwHF诱导KI的靶点。PPI网络、基因表达分析和GO功能富集分析揭示了关键生物过程，并提示TwHF诱导KI的机制可能与炎症、免疫反应、缺氧及氧化应激相关。KEGG通路富集分析表明，PI3K-Akt信号通路、HIF-1信号通路和TNF信号通路是TwHF诱导KI的关键信号通路。分子对接显示，核心靶点与毒性化合物的结合能均小于-6.5 kcal/mol，这验证了网络药理学的筛选能力，并为修饰TwHF毒性化合物结构提供了证据。通过本研究，我们揭示了TwHF诱导KI的机制，即TwHF可能激活PI3K-Akt信号通路及TNF信号通路以促进肾脏炎症，通过HIF-1信号通路介导缺氧以加速炎症过程，同时也为修饰TwHF毒性化合物结构提供了理论基础，并支持了后续研究。
